retained.blurb: Every research tree (Government, Military and Magic) offers one more technology to choose from (4 instead of 3).
retained.name: Retained Knowledge

retained2.blurb: Every research tree (Government, Military and Magic) offers one more technology again (5 to choose from).
retained2.name: Retained Knowledge II

rift.blurb: Pick any explored province you may enter (your land, unclaimed land, or a nation you are at war or in a truce with): after 3 seconds of casting (100 mana) the Mage and his army are carried there. 2-minute cooldown for the nation.
rift.name: Teleportation Rift

risen.blurb: Autocast: the first time a soldier of the army falls in a battle, the Mage spends 50 mana and the dead rise: that soldier and the next 4 to fall get straight back up, looking rather worse for it (same strength). Then it stops; when the battle ends it has a 2-minute cooldown. One Mage keeps this or Cursed Weapons ready, not both.
risen.name: Risen Dead

roads.blurb: Masons can build a dirt road across an open border (75 wood, 25 gold). Units move 25% faster along it.
roads.name: Dirt Roads

roads2.blurb: Every road is relaid in gravel: units move 35% faster along roads.
roads2.name: Gravel Roads

roads3.blurb: Every road is paved with cobbles: units move 50% faster along roads.
roads3.name: Cobblestone Roads

rockarmor.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Druid starts a battle, plates of stone gather round it: a shield worth 10% of the army’s total health soaks up the damage before any soldier is hurt.
rockarmor.name: Rock Armor

s-kite.blurb: Kite Shield for one-handed designs: +6 armor.
s-kite.name: Kite Shields

s-round.blurb: Round Shield for one-handed designs: +3 armor.
s-round.name: Round Shields

s-tower.blurb: Tower Shield for one-handed designs: +10 armor, but 8% slower.
s-tower.name: Tower Shields

sacredpyre.blurb: A Warlock standing in one of your provinces raises a Sacred Pyre there (3 seconds of casting, 100 mana and 200 wood). For 1 minute that province makes 110 more gold every 10 s. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.
sacredpyre.name: Sacred Pyre

sanctum.blurb: Lets a Mage Tower be upgraded to a Mage Sanctum (Magic Tier II).
sanctum.name: Mage Sanctum

school-arcane.blurb: Commit to Arcane magic: far sight from towers, mind reading, trading across worlds, traps and rifts.
school-arcane.name: School of the Arcane

school-death.blurb: Commit to Necromancy: cursed weapons, mountain passages, the risen dead and grave riches.
school-death.name: School of Necromancy

school-elemental.blurb: Commit to Elemental magic: rock armor, whispering rocks, forest spirits, town portals and a grand elemental of living water.
school-elemental.name: School of the Elements

school-life.blurb: Commit to Herbomancy: harvests, protective skins, healing and the forest.
school-life.name: School of Herbomancy

school-pyro.blurb: Commit to Pyromancy: fiery weapons, scouting pyres, fire traps, sacred pyres and paths of fire.
school-pyro.name: School of Pyromancy

scoutpyre.blurb: A Warlock lights a pyre where he stands (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana). For 1 minute it sees every neighboring province in its line of sight. 1-minute cooldown per Warlock.
scoutpyre.name: Scouting Pyre

scoutsight.blurb: Your scouts (Wayfinders, Scouts, Swampstriders) learn Scout Sight: after 5 seconds of focus a scout detects every unit in his field of vision, sneaking ones too, for as long as he holds still. He can’t move or sneak meanwhile: ordering him to move ends it.
scoutsight.name: Scout Sight

sealed.blurb: A Mage can seal a mountain tunnel again with 10 seconds of casting (200 mana).
sealed.name: Sealed Gates

skin.blurb: Autocast (50 mana, no cooldown): when an army with a Mage starts a battle, its soldiers get +5% health.
skin.name: Hardened Skin

skull-cracked.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Cracked Skull in the off hand: +1 attack, and the Fireball casts 2 s faster. Set it in the Armory.
skull-cracked.name: Cracked Skulls

skull-flawless.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Flawless Skull in the off hand: +3 attack, and the Fireball casts 6 s faster.
skull-flawless.name: Flawless Skulls

skull-polished.blurb: Warlocks with a wand can hold a Polished Skull in the off hand: +2 attack, and the Fireball casts 4 s faster.
skull-polished.name: Polished Skulls

sophmills.blurb: Every Lumber Mill gives another +1 wood.
sophmills.name: Sophisticated Lumber Mills

sophmines.blurb: Every Gold Mine gives another +2 gold.
sophmines.name: Sophisticated Gold Mines

stable.blurb: Unlocks the Stable, which lets a Barracks in the same province train Cavalry.
stable.name: Building: Stable

stasis.blurb: A Mage sets a trap in his province (3 seconds of casting, 50 mana); the next enemy army there can’t leave for 10 seconds (it can still fight). One trap at a time; no cooldown.
stasis.name: Stasis Trap

stealth.blurb: Wayfinders can sneak: three times slower, but enemy armies can’t see them. Without it, an enemy army that finds a Wayfinder kills him.
stealth.name: Wayfinder Stealth

stockmarket.blurb: Trading gives 2 of each resource for every 3 points of mana.
stockmarket.name: Interdimensional Stockmarket

storehouse.blurb: Unlocks the Storehouse: +1000 wood storage each (the nation starts able to hold 2000).
storehouse.name: Building: Storehouse

terrascape.blurb: A Mage grows a line of trees along an open border, with a forest path left open in the middle: only a path through the trees remains. 5 minutes of casting, 100 mana.
terrascape.name: Terrascaping

thugs2.blurb: Every Thug Den holds one more Thug (3 instead of 2).
thugs2.name: Thugging Benefits Program

thugs3.blurb: Every Thug Den holds one more Thug again (4).
thugs3.name: Thugging Stock Options

townportal.blurb: After 3 seconds of casting (100 mana), a Druid and the army he is in are carried to your capital. 5-minute cooldown per Druid.
townportal.name: Town Portal

traderoutes.blurb: Your capital makes +1 gold for every Marketplace it can reach by road, through any number of your provinces.
traderoutes.name: Trade Routes

trading.blurb: A 3-second cast that spends all of the Mage’s mana: 1 food, 1 gold and 1 wood for every 3 points. Then the nation waits 3 minutes.
trading.name: Interdimensional Trading

twohand.blurb: Protectors can be designed to fight two-handed (set the grip in the Armory): every other round they deal nothing, and the next a blow 2.5 times as hard, 125% of their damage over time. Champions fight this way without it.
twohand.name: Two-Handed Grip

underworld.blurb: A Mage standing in a province you own or occupy can open a tunnel through a mountain border after 20 seconds of casting (200 mana).
underworld.name: Underworld Passage

w-bastard.blurb: Bastard Sword for the Armory: attack 10, one-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-bastard.name: Bastard Swords

w-battleaxe.blurb: Battle Axe for the Armory: attack 14, one-handed. Critical strike: each blow has a 10% chance to do double damage.
w-battleaxe.name: Battle Axes

w-bearded.blurb: Bearded Axe for the Armory: attack 10, one-handed. Critical strike: each blow has a 10% chance to do double damage.
w-bearded.name: Bearded Axes

w-braidedsling.blurb: Your Slingers trade the Wool Sling for the Braided Sling: attack 9 (from 6). Every Slinger you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-braidedsling.name: Braided Slings

w-compositebow.blurb: Your Archers trade the Short Bow for the Composite Bow: attack 9 (from 6). Every Archer you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-compositebow.name: Composite Bows

w-estoc.blurb: Estoc for the Armory: attack 20, one-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-estoc.name: Estocs

w-gladius.blurb: Gladius for the Armory: attack 10, one-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-gladius.name: Gladius

w-greatsword.blurb: Great Sword for the Armory: attack 30, two-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-greatsword.name: Great Swords

w-halberd.blurb: Halberd for the Armory: attack 18, two-handed. +50% damage against cavalry.
w-halberd.name: Halberds

w-leathersling.blurb: Your Slingers trade the Braided Sling for the Leather Sling: attack 12 (from 9). Every Slinger you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-leathersling.name: Leather Slings

w-levercrossbow.blurb: Your Crossbowmen trade the Hand-drawn Crossbow for the Lever Crossbow: attack 9 (from 6). Every Crossbowman you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-levercrossbow.name: Lever Crossbows

w-longbow.blurb: Your Archers trade the Composite Bow for the Long Bow: attack 12 (from 9). Every Archer you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-longbow.name: Long Bows

w-longsword.blurb: Long Sword for the Armory: attack 14, one-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-longsword.name: Long Swords

w-mace.blurb: Mace for the Armory: attack 8, one-handed. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.
w-mace.name: Maces

w-morningstar.blurb: Morning Star for the Armory: attack 11, one-handed. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.
w-morningstar.name: Morning Stars

w-pike.blurb: Pike for the Armory: attack 9, two-handed. +50% damage against cavalry.
w-pike.name: Pikes

w-polearm.blurb: Polearm for the Armory: attack 13, two-handed. +50% damage against cavalry.
w-polearm.name: Polearms

w-rapier.blurb: Rapier for the Armory: attack 14, one-handed. Parry: take 10% less damage.
w-rapier.name: Rapiers

w-waraxe.blurb: War Axe for the Armory: attack 20, one-handed. Critical strike: each blow has a 10% chance to do double damage.
w-waraxe.name: War Axes

w-warhammer.blurb: War Hammer for the Armory: attack 15, one-handed. Crushing: ignores half of enemy armor, and deals 150% damage to soldiers in plate.
w-warhammer.name: War Hammers

w-windlass.blurb: Your Crossbowmen trade the Lever Crossbow for the Windlass Crossbow: attack 12 (from 9). Every Crossbowman you have is re-armed at once, in the field too.
w-windlass.name: Windlass Crossbows

walls.blurb: Masons can close an open border with a wooden palisade (150 wood, 100 gold). Every wall has a gate that only its owner’s units can pass. Forts raise walls with gates on all their open borders.
walls.name: Wooden Walls

walls2.blurb: Walls are built of stone, and existing palisades are rebuilt in stone: three times as strong.
walls2.name: Stone Walls

warforge.blurb: Lets a Battle Forge be upgraded to a War Forge (Military Tier III).
warforge.name: War Forge

wrocks.blurb: A Druid raises whispering stones on a mountain border of the province he stands in (3 seconds of casting, 25 mana): both provinces on either side are in sight for 1 minute.
wrocks.name: Whispering Rocks
